info.title: Xenode Internal API
info.description:
🔒 **INTERNAL USE ONLY** — This API reference is for internal development and integration purposes. All endpoints require authentication via session cookie or API key bearer token.

Xenode is a zero-knowledge encrypted cloud storage platform. The backend never sees raw file contents or unencrypted keys. All E2EE operations (encrypt, decrypt, key wrapping) are performed client-side.

get.summary: Compare organization storage counters with retained object metadata
get.description: Read-only snapshot across the organization's organization and team Spaces, including suspended/deleted Spaces, Bin objects, derivatives and retained versions. Uncommitted uploads are not charged. Returns only counters and differences (computed minus recorded); never repairs usage or plan state and never reads R2 bytes. A malformed source or scan over 100,000 objects produces no computed totals or repair delta. Requires a current Admin session; user ProductSessions and API keys do not authorize this endpoint.

200.description: Snapshot report (including drift, missing usage or incomplete/invalid data)

503.description: The snapshot could not be read

delete.summary: Suspend an organization for its 30-day recovery window
delete.description: Owner only. Suspends the organization and team Spaces atomically with the soft-delete marker. Existing shares stop issuing URLs. Billing cancellation follows the database transition.

409.description: Organization cannot enter recovery

get.description: Requires organization owner/admin access. Returns existing Usage or free defaults without creating billing or audit records.

post.summary: Restore an organization before retirement starts
post.description: Owner only. The organization and suspended Spaces reactivate in one transaction. Recovery closes when the 30-day window expires or permanent retirement begins.

409.description: Recovery window closed

delete.summary: Retire a team Space and its encrypted objects
delete.description: Owner or admin only. A transaction disables the team Space and bins active objects. B2 deletion and quota retirement use the per-object purge ledger. Repeat while cleanupPending is true; the authenticated hourly cron also continues it. Parent records and product keys survive until all object and upload cleanup completes.

202.description: Cleanup pending; encrypted objects or upload manifests remain

409.description: Space or storage invariant prevents retirement

get.description: Requires CRON_SECRET bearer authentication. Bounded per-Space work confirms exact B2 deletion before atomically retiring object metadata, quota and bucket accounting. Parent rows are removed only after every child object and replayable upload is gone.

200.description: Sweep completed with no storage failures; parents may still be pending

500.description: Storage deletion or sweep failure; durable state remains for retry

Returns files and folders with full metadata, signed thumbnail/optimized URLs. Supports pagination, filtering by bucket/folder, content type, and media category.

parameters.name: folder
parameters.description: Direct children of one folder: a folder id or 'root'. Omit to list the whole Space.

get.description: Returns pre-signed download URL (or chunk URLs for chunked files) with encryption metadata.

delete.description: Moves the object into the Bin. Physical deletion and quota release occur through the permanent-deletion lifecycle.

post.description: JSON control only. Require x-xenode-base-revision. Send operation=presign with ciphertext size and fresh base64 12-byte iv, PUT directly to the returned B2 URL, then send operation=complete with sessionId. Metadata, retained history and owner byte accounting commit transactionally. Binary bodies and in-place overwrites are rejected.

get.description: Returns current revision and up to ten available snapshots; pending deletion entries stay charged but are omitted.

delete.summary: Schedule a historical version for deletion
delete.description: Requires Space deletion permission. Keeps exact blob references and charged bytes until the authenticated cleanup cron confirms B2 removal.

409.description: Protected original

post.description: Requires Space write permission and the current base revision. Moves metadata only, preserving pending cleanup and physical accounting.

409.description: Stale base revision or deletion pending

post.description: Requires Space delete permission. Each request queues at most 100 binned objects with immutable deletion metadata. Exact B2 deletion precedes atomic object/share/album retirement and owner quota release. Known PUT grace windows delay cleanup; purge intent cannot be restored.

202.description: Deletion queued; bytes remain charged until confirmation

409.description: Version cleanup pending

post.description: Requires Space write permission. Rechecks selected objects, descendants and sidecars. Purge intent blocks restore; no B2 transfer or quota change occurs.

409.description: Permanent deletion already started

post.description: Requires Space manage permission. Folders are metadata records with no blob and the opaque key <spaceRoot><folderId>/. The client chooses the folder id so the encrypted name can be bound to it. Plaintext names are not accepted.

folderId.description: New folder id chosen by the client (12 random bytes, lowercase hex)

encryptedDisplayName.description: Folder name sealed with the Space metadata key, bound to folderId (xenode-file/1 metadata, purpose name)

parentFolderId.description: Live parent folder in the same Space; null or omitted for the Space root

400.description: Missing or malformed folder id, missing encrypted name, or nesting deeper than 32 folders

409.description: folder_id_conflict: the folder id is already in use

404.description: Bucket or parent folder not found in this Space

409.description: Space inactive or storage usage not initialized

delete.summary: Move a folder to the Bin
delete.description: Requires Space delete permission. The folder, its live descendants and their sidecars share one deletedAt so restore and purge act on exactly that batch.

404.description: Live folder not found in this Space

post.description: Requires Space manage permission. Changes folder placement metadata only; physical keys, chunks, versions and signed URLs are untouched. Items inside another selected folder move with it.

destinationFolderId.description: Live folder in the same Space, or null for the Space root

400.description: Invalid selection, folder moved into itself or a descendant, or nesting deeper than 32 folders

404.description: Selected item or destination folder not found in this Space

get.summary: Get lightweight object metadata (IDs + dates only)
get.description: Returns `{ _id, createdAt }` for every object in a bucket in a single unpaginated response. Used by the gallery to layout placeholders and the scrubber timeline. ~25 KB gzipped for 5,000 photos.

post.description: Returns full object data with signed thumbnail/optimized URLs for a batch of IDs. Max 200 IDs per request. Uses POST to avoid URL length limits and prevent CDN caching of short-TTL signed URLs.

Select a personal, organization or team Space with x-xenode-space-id or spaceId query. The server checks that Space owner's initialized quota, issues an opaque object key and reserves it before signing a direct-to-R2 S3 PUT with If-None-Match: *. The browser must send that signed header. A repeated PUT returns R2 precondition failure instead of overwriting ciphertext; restart with a fresh reservation if the original bytes cannot be recovered. Presign does not change plan state. Refresh the same upload with its returned sessionId. A thumbnail or optimized variant requires parentSessionId and variant.

sessionId.description: Reservation ID required when refreshing an existing upload key

parentSessionId.description: Parent reservation ID required for a secondary ciphertext blob

409.description: Key collision, invalid upload reservation or uninitialized quota state

post.description: Select a personal, organization or team Space with x-xenode-space-id or spaceId query. The server checks that Space owner's initialized quota, issues an opaque logical key and reserves its chunks before signing create-only R2 S3 PUT URLs. Every chunk PUT must include the signed If-None-Match: * header. Presign does not change plan state. Refresh the same key with its returned sessionId.

sessionId.description: Reservation ID required when refreshing an existing upload key

200.description: Multipart upload URLs, sessionId and resolved Space identity generated

409.description: Key collision, invalid upload reservation or uninitialized quota state

post.summary: Complete a personal, organization or team upload
post.description: Select the personal, organization or team Space with x-xenode-space-id or spaceId query. Verifies R2 ciphertext lengths and atomically finalizes the exact reservation, StorageObject, Space owner quota and bucket counters. Variant bytes count against quota. Retrying the same completed reservation returns its exact object without repeating writes. Fingerprint/key conflicts return 409 and leave the upload pending for retry or orphan cleanup. Existing objects use a separate revision flow.

sessionId.description: Exact upload reservation returned by presign

size.description: Actual ciphertext bytes of the main blob, or sum of all chunk ciphertext lengths

optimizedKey.description: Claimed optimized ciphertext blob; must exist in B2

optimizedSize.description: Optional assertion checked against B2; server always records the actual length

thumbnailSize.description: Optional assertion checked against B2; server always records the actual length

folderId.description: Live folder in the upload's Space; null or omitted for the Space root. Sidecars inherit their parent file's folder.

chunkIvs.description: JSON-encoded IV array in chunk order; count must match chunkCount

400.description: Invalid encrypted metadata or chunk layout

402.description: Actual ciphertext bytes exceed the Space owner's quota

404.description: Bucket, destination folder or required ciphertext blob is missing

409.description: Size mismatch, unavailable quota state, or upload/key/fingerprint conflict

get.description: Returns a signed download URL for a thumbnail by its B2 key. Auth is optional for `shares/` prefixed keys.

403.description: Forbidden — key doesn't belong to user

post.description: Returns signed thumbnail URLs for multiple objects at once.

Validates and writes the active Space and every selected object in one transaction with link creation. A concurrent permanent purge or Space suspension returns a conflict instead of leaving an orphan link.

items.description: Bundle items, each carrying an objectId and encrypted per-file share material

409.description: A selected object or its Space changed during creation

get.description: A permanent object purge removes the object from surviving bundles, moves the bundle primary pointer, and deletes empty links. Suspended Spaces do not disclose link details.

409.description: Share changed concurrently; reload before editing

post.description: Validates access (password if required) and returns a signed download URL. For a bundle, omitted itemId selects the first surviving item.
Returns a streaming URL for preview/playback of shared content.
Shares an encrypted file directly with specific users. Each recipient gets a wrapped share key for their own vault.

200.description: List of direct shares created by the user
Files shared directly with the user

post.description: Looks up users by email for the direct share recipient picker.
Initializes the user's cryptographic vault for E2EE operations.

get.description: Returns up to 10 API keys for the authenticated user.

post.description: Creates a Razorpay recurring subscription. Supports coupon codes and auto-applied campaign offers. Idempotent with `Idempotency-Key` header.

409.description: Active subscription already exists

post.description: Verifies Razorpay payment signature after checkout.
Upgrade or downgrade. Supports `immediate` or `period_end` effective modes. Computes proration informationally. Idempotent.

409.description: Subscription not active

get.description: Returns up to 100 invoices for the authenticated user, newest first. Joined with subscription data for plan/cycle info.

post.description: Receives Razorpay payment event webhooks (payment.authorized, payment.captured, payment.failed, etc.).
Handles subscription lifecycle events (subscription.activated, subscription.charged, subscription.cancelled, etc.).

get.description: Returns all Google Photos migration jobs for the authenticated user.

post.description: ⚠️ Debug endpoint — flushes migration-related Redis keys.

get.description: Returns current sync state for keeping mobile app caches up to date.

get.summary: Get file by bucket and key path
get.description: Direct file access via bucket name and full key path.

post.description: Initializes missing Drive billing Usage through the canonical entitlement service. Existing paid state and storage counters are preserved; returns the effective plan and quota. Accounts onboarding and storage-pool selection are separate.

409.description: Subscription scope or plan configuration is invalid

get.description: Processes up to 200 due personal and 200 due organization entitlements, rechecking each transactionally. Grace deadlines derive from recorded expiry; delayed runs do not extend them. Returns personal and organization grace/expiry counts. Preserves storage counters. Requires `Authorization: Bearer <CRON_SECRET>`.
Syncs local subscription state with Razorpay. Requires `Authorization: Bearer <CRON_SECRET>`.

post.description: Issues a host-only, eight-hour HS256 Admin JWT with issuer xenode-drive-admin, audience xenode-admin and current Admin sessionVersion. Requires an explicit ADMIN_JWT_SECRET of at least 32 characters. Every authenticated Admin request checks current database status, role and version.

401.description: Not authenticated, revoked, disabled, deleted, role-stale or version-stale Admin token

get.description: Returns aggregate stats: total users, storage usage, active subscriptions, revenue, etc.

patch.description: Update manual plan/quota overrides through the canonical entitlement writer. Live provider plan or expiry changes return 409. Quotas are nonnegative safe integers; null storage limit means unlimited. Preserves storage counters and commits a sanitized audit event.

400.description: Invalid body, plan, date or quota

409.description: Live provider subscription or idempotency conflict

post.description: Assign or revoke a manual plan through the canonical entitlement writer. Resolves the plan quota and clears old autopay/campaign/grace state. Refuses a live provider subscription; manage it through the subscription lifecycle first.

200.description: Plan, quota, identity projection and audit committed

409.description: Live provider subscription or idempotency conflict

patch.summary: Change Admin role or active status and revoke existing tokens
patch.description: Requires a current super-admin. The update atomically increments sessionVersion, including disable/re-enable and repeated changes. Prior tokens remain invalid after re-enable; fresh credential login is required.

200.description: Admin updated without passwordHash; prior tokens revoked

delete.summary: Delete admin account and invalidate its tokens

post.description: Cancel the exact provider subscription and project its personal or organization entitlement through the canonical writer. Supports Idempotency-Key and preserves the remaining paid period unless refunded.

get.description: Revenue, MRR, churn, conversion metrics.

post.description: Upload files for admin purposes (blog images, etc.).

adminCookieAuth.name: __Host-Xenode_admin_session
adminCookieAuth.description: Drive Admin JWT cookie, validated against the current Admin record and session version. Development uses Xenode_admin_session. This is separate from user authentication.

bearerAuth.description: API key authentication. Generate keys via `POST /api/keys`.

cookieAuth.name: better-auth.session_token
cookieAuth.description: Session cookie managed by better-auth. 7-day expiry, auto-refreshes every 24h.

cronAuth.description: Cron job secret token (CRON_SECRET env var).
